offers.title: Business websites
offers.suitableFor: Small businesses that need to explain their services and turn interest into an enquiry.
offers.deliverable: A responsive website with service pages, clear contact paths, search metadata and deployment.
features: Content and navigation shaped around your customers
Source code and a guide to updating the content
offers.exampleName: Layer 3D — services, material comparison and LINE quote requests

offers.title: Interactive web products
offers.suitableFor: Founders and product teams testing a useful tool or turning a defined workflow into an application.
offers.deliverable: A working web application with forms, application logic and clear results, ready to put in front of users.
features: A focused scope built around the main user journey
Tests for critical behavior and a documented handoff
offers.exampleName: Perd Wai — planning inputs, scenario comparisons and forecasts

offers.title: Connected business tools
offers.suitableFor: Teams that need staff workflows, customer interactions and operational data to work together.
offers.deliverable: An application connecting the agreed interfaces, API and database, with access rules and reporting for each role.
features: Staff and admin interfaces tailored to their tasks
API and data integration for the core workflow
offers.exampleName: Cafe’nMe — checkout, shop admin and LINE membership

process.title: Discovery
process.description: We discuss your project requirements, goals, and timeline.

process.title: Proposal
process.description: I provide a detailed proposal with scope, timeline, and pricing.

process.title: Development
process.description: I build your solution with regular updates and iterations.

process.title: Delivery
process.description: Final review, deployment, and handoff with documentation.
